candidates.name: kubo-rpc-client
candidates.fit_for_gap: G2/G3 — shared kubo RPC client base for plugin (WebView) and Node CLI

maintenance.note: repo pushed 2026-08-10, not archived; maintainers Protocol/lidel

evidence.claim: kubo-rpc-client 7.1.0 published 2026-06-09, actively maintained by Protocol
client encodes all API args as URL search params (src/lib/to-url-search-params.ts), surviving our proxy's quirk of dropping form-encoded args
runtime-agnostic fetch-based implementation, safe to bundle for Obsidian WebView and run under Node 24

risks: files/write multipart file field name must be 'data' per our proxy quirk — verify at plan time; wrap just that call if it differs
wrapper must remain the single place proxy quirks live (assessment risk 1)
candidates.decision_rationale: Base of src/rpc/ shared module; thin wrapper for proxy quirks and IO injection keeps quirk handling in exactly one place.

candidates.name: @ipld/car
candidates.fit_for_gap: G2/G6 — CAR export/import for >32MB files and disaster recovery

evidence.claim: ipfs-car 3.1.0 (2025-10) considered but lower-level @ipld/car preferred for control over the MFS-layout contract

risks: CAR reassembly into MFS layout is our code; library handles codec only
candidates.decision_rationale: Used inside our own exporter/importer for large-file chunked CAR packaging and vault disaster recovery.

candidates.name: @electric-sql/pglite
candidates.fit_for_gap: G5 — StoreAdapter implementation (vectors + metadata) for the event bus and indexing hooks

evidence.claim: PGlite 0.5.8 published 2026-08-26, actively maintained embedded Postgres (WASM)
pglite ships contrib extensions including pgvector for in-browser/WASM vector search

risks: metadata + sync-state adoption confirmed for MVP; vector columns are conditional on verifying pgvector availability in the 0.5.8 contrib set at plan time (adapter ships metadata-only if unconfirmed; interface unchanged when vectors land)
candidates.decision_rationale: Operator decision (2026-09-29): MVP ships a real PGlite StoreAdapter instead of a no-op, so event/indexing seams are exercised for real; SurrealDB WASM graph adapter deferred to a later phase. Verdict split per review finding: metadata adopt confirmed, vector support conditional.

candidates.name: @ucanto/core + @ucanto/principal
candidates.fit_for_gap: Security track (post-MVP token gating) — UCAN capability tokens for device identity and authz

evidence.claim: @ucanto/core 10.4.6 and @ucanto/principal 9.0.3 maintained (Storacha/UCAN-wg), dual Apache-2.0 AND MIT
UCAN spec: offline-validated attenuated capability tokens; no server required — matches decentralized security research recommendation

risks: lands after MVP sync core; proxy-side validation is a server prerequisite tracked in DESIGN §5
candidates.decision_rationale: Confirms spec 011 Q6 UCAN pick is maintained; adopt when token gating phase starts.

candidates.name: @noble/curves
candidates.fit_for_gap: Security track — SPAKE2 (RFC 9382) curve backend for device pairing

evidence.claim: SPAKE2 is the standard PAKE for short-code/QR device pairing per RFC 9382; JS protocol implementations are scarce so the state machine is a small build item on top of noble curves

risks: SPAKE2 protocol state machine (~300 LOC) is our build item, not a library
candidates.decision_rationale: Spec 011 Q6 pick confirmed maintained; post-MVP pairing work.

candidates.name: @napi-rs/keyring
candidates.fit_for_gap: G1 — OS keychain storage for kubo RPC tokens in the Node CLI (spec 011 Q4)

evidence.claim: @napi-rs/keyring 2.1.0 published 2026-09-13, active, prebuilt napi binaries incl. Windows
keytar 7.9.0 (2025-07) is maintenance mode with native-build pain on Windows — rejected as primary, kept only as fallback

risks: native N-API module — must live in a Node-only CLI package/path, never imported by plugin/WebView code, never in the esbuild plugin bundle (review finding; plan constraint)
Obsidian plugin keeps plugin-data/machine-key storage per spec 011 Q4; mobile keychain is a later-phase item
candidates.decision_rationale: Cross-platform keychain for the CLI without native build fragility.

candidates.name: didcomm-node
candidates.fit_for_gap: Security track — DIDComm v2 messaging (post-MVP, specs 005/008 transport ambitions)

maintenance.note: STALE — no releases in over 3 years

evidence.claim: didcomm-node 0.4.1 last modified 2023-05 — dormant, flagged stale

risks: adopting a dormant package for the messaging layer would import maintenance debt
candidates.decision_rationale: Rejected for now (messaging is post-MVP anyway); re-evaluate DIDComm alternatives at that phase rather than committing to a stale package.

build_required.why_no_candidate: Vault-diff semantics and manifest schema are project-specific (DESIGN §4); no library encodes our MFS layout contract

build_required.need: EventBus, HostBridge, StoreAdapter seams (typed TS interfaces + in-memory/first implementations)
build_required.why_no_candidate: Seams are deliberately library-free so future phases (007 records, 006 indexing, 005 WASM) plug into frozen interfaces without inherited dependencies

build_required.need: SPAKE2 protocol state machine on @noble/curves (~300 LOC, RFC 9382)
build_required.why_no_candidate: maintained JS SPAKE2 implementations are scarce; protocol build on audited curve primitives fits spec 005's crypto posture

build_required.need: Per-file publish/pull pool with 8MB chunking and WebView memory discipline
build_required.why_no_candidate: WebView memory rules + proxy quirks + MFS staging layout are project constraints no generic uploader encodes

build_required.need: Settings/UX shell and agentic chat UI scaffolding (future-phase surface, seams declared in MVP)
build_required.why_no_candidate: UI contract is specified in docs/010; implementation is project code, not a library concern
